But I'm not certain if those are considered in this context. If the question is about general cells, then mitochondria would be common.

Option C includes the nucleus, cell wall, and cell membrane. Hmm, cell walls are only in plant cells, right? Animals don't have cell walls, but maybe the question is considering the cell membrane as part of the structure. So, if the question is about common structures, the cell wall wouldn't be common to both. So, option C might be incorrect because it includes the cell wall, which is not present in animal cells.
